keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 underwater macro nature photo at the muddy bottom of a Mekong delta river canal. Soft green sunlight filters down through slightly murky water. A few dark tree roots and sunken brown leaves lie on the fine mud in the background, softly blurred. The camera is placed at the level of the bottom. In the center stands one adult female giant freshwater prawn, seen from the side, head facing left, body slightly diagonal. She has a smooth translucent blue-brown shell, a pointed serrated rostrum, long thin antennae, two medium slender claws and thin walking legs. Under her abdomen, held among her swimming legs inside the curved sides of her abdomen, is a large dense mass of thousands of tiny oval bright orange eggs. The eggs are only under her abdomen, none on the mud. Her body is about half of the frame width, in the center. Keep everything important away from the left and right edges. Only one prawn. No text, no watermark.

It is about one twelfth of the frame width. Only one prawn. No text, no watermark.

It is about one quarter of the frame width. Only one prawn. No text, no watermark.
